name: Pigafetta
description: The crawler inside Visual SEO Studio, a desktop SEO auditing tool, which walks a site's structure and HTML pages to assess technical SEO. Its bot page is an unusually explicit statement of crawling manners: it uses one explicit agent name, checks robots.txt before entering a domain or subdomain, takes the most restrictive reading of conflicting rules, obeys robots meta tags, X-Robots-Tag and rel=nofollow, caps Crawl-delay handling at 2 seconds, waits for each response to complete before issuing the next request, and sends a From header so site owners can make contact.
